Nutrient levels for 100g 📖 Knowledge Panels
How does salt intake affect my health? ▾

Consuming too much salt (sodium) can raise blood pressure, which increases the risk of heart disease and stroke. WHO recommends less than 5g of salt per day.

Why monitor free and added sugars? ▾

High sugar intake is linked to weight gain and tooth decay. Public health agencies advise limiting free sugars to less than 5-10% of daily energy intake.

DESIGNED IN SKETCH & FIGMA • BUILT WITH FLUTTER

Every Screen & Flow from Smooth App V2, Interactive

Click any capability card below to jump the interactive phone simulator directly to that screen and test the live user flow.

Instant Barcode Scanner & Scan Card V2

Sub-second barcode recognition works even with weak connectivity. Displays Nutri-Score, NOVA group, Green-Score, and your personal compatibility score in a single glance.

modular Knowledge Panels & Equivalents

Server-driven Knowledge Panels explain WHO/NHS nutrient thresholds, NOVA 4 ultra-processing markers, carbon equivalents in car kilometers, and threatened species.

100% Private Personalization & Allergen Alerts

Set 4-level importance weights (Mandatory to Not Important) for allergens, vegan/vegetarian diets, palm oil, additives, and environmental impact — computed entirely on your phone.

Open Prices: Crowd-Sourced Inflation Tracker

Compare real store prices around you, upload shelf tags or store receipts with automatic barcode matching, and help researchers track food prices globally.

Nutri-Sight AI, OCR Spellcheck & Hunger Games

Machine learning models extract nutrition tables from angled photos, fix ingredient OCR typos in 70+ languages, and turn data validation into a rewarding game.

One App, 4 Open Facts Universes + Folksonomy

Seamlessly scan Food, Cosmetics (INCI & cruelty-free labels), Pet Food, and Everyday Products with community-defined Folksonomy key-value properties.
